about: The mobile BioCLIP 2.5 (FastViT, 11.6M parameters; a third party's upload, MIT by its card) vectors for the world tuning, test and casual photos (lab/world-eval on pub/data-world), to measure whether a larger encoder in the base app lets the nineteen groups pass their marks (docs/COVERAGE.md). A measurement only. Publishes after run 39 so that the two never race.
